statement:
by
  classical
  exact let R := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.log 2 n)).filter (fun e => Nat.Prime (n-2^e))).card; ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, T ≤ X → X ≤ H^2 → H ≤ X → 13*H ≤ 100*((Finset.Ico X (X+H)).filter (fun n => Odd n ∧ 0 < R n)).card

plain_statement.zh: 每个长度至少 √X 的窗口中，至少 13% 的全部整数是奇素数加一个正指数二幂。
plain_statement.en: Represent at least 13% of all integers in every window of length at least √X as an odd prime and a positive power of two.

brief.zh: Johnston–Trudgian v2 第 1.2 节记录的全区间下密度为 0.10788。此题同时提高该基线并要求短窗一致；分母是全部整数。局部化表示数的一、二阶矩，特别检验筛法误差对窗口起点的依赖。单个奇数的表示只给出反射法的一侧。
brief.en: Section 1.2 of Johnston–Trudgian v2 records a full-range lower density of 0.10788 among all integers. Strengthen that numerical baseline and localize the first and second moments to each moving window. This is one side of a reflection argument.
